cases.summary: `My password` string in `Signing in` page not getting translated in `keycloak.v3 account` theme
cases.description: ### Before reporting an issue - [ ] I have read and understood the above terms for submitting issues, and I understand that my issue may be closed without action if I do not follow them. ### Area account/ui ### Describe the bug `My password` string in `Signing in` page not getting translated to other languages. I update account UI language(locale) as Portuguese add added in `messages_pt_BR.properties` file as `password=Minha senha` but not reflecting in Account UI. This issue I faced in all languages. ### Version v25.0.2 ### Regression - [ ] The issue is a regression ### Expected behavior Need to convert selected language. ### Actual behavior Not converting selected language. ### How to Reproduce? Change `Select a locale` other than English go to Signing in page and check `Basic authentication` lists ### Anything else? _No response_
